title: Pump.fun program and fixture provenance research
objective: Produce a reproducible evidence pack for the Pump.fun decoder: official program and IDL version sources, version-selection rules, and Owner-authorized fixed create, buy, sell and migrate transaction fixtures with retrieval watermarks and SHA-256 hashes.
forbidden_actions: Do not use a mutable fixture URL as evidence without recording the retrieval watermark and SHA-256 hash.
Do not infer Pump instruction semantics from secondary sources when an official source is available.
Do not add secrets, provider keys, request headers, raw provider envelopes or an Owner-unapproved CA to the repository.
Retain only the minimum scrubbed, finalized on-chain transaction fields required for deterministic fixture replay.
